title: 第1553章 统帅你靠关系上来的吧第1552章 击杀孙冲
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
吴大奎虽然是真神境，但面对秦峰的实力，他真的不够看。
他连反应的时间都没有，只觉得一股凛冽杀意扑面而来。
立刻拿起长枪挡在胸前，然而下一刻，他连人带枪直接倒飞了出去，砸在城墙之上。
枪杆弯成弓形，他的后背狠狠撞上坚硬的墙砖，碎石簌簌落下。
嘴角不断的冒血，肋骨都断了好几根。鲜血顺着下巴滴落，他疼得面色惨白。
吴大奎道：“秦大人，书院可是有规定，禁止同门相残。”
他捂着胸口，声音发颤，但仍试图用规矩来压住秦峰的怒火。
“你作为监察使，知法犯法可是罪加一等。后果你能承担得起吗？”
他偷偷瞄了一眼统帅府的方向，心里盼着汤玉辉能快点赶到。
虽然他嘴上硬气，他实际上他早就已经给汤玉辉传讯了。
他也没想到秦峰居然这么强，远远超出了他的预料。
原本以为祈灵神朝能轻松解决掉这两人，谁知局势竟发生了变化。
秦峰却冷笑一声：“你现在知道不能同门相残了，早干什么去了？”
他向前逼近一步，剑锋上的雷光还未散尽，噼啪作响。
“你之前不开城门，把我们关在外面，差点害死我们，你怎么不说禁止同门相残呢？”
那一句质问，如重锤敲在在场所有守卫的心头，无人敢应声。
吴大奎立刻换成一副笑脸：“之前那不也是职责所在吗？”
他努力堆起讨好的笑容，伤口却让他龇牙咧嘴，滑稽又狼狈。
“还请秦兄大人不记小人过，我下次再也不敢了。”
此刻突然有一股恐怖的气息从统帅府那边传了过来，显然是汤玉辉正向这边赶来。

那股威压如同山岳倾倒，城楼上的士兵们纷纷低头弯腰，噤若寒蝉。
秦峰冷笑：“你以为通知统帅就能保住你的命？”说着他拔剑就是一斩。
剑光如白虹贯日，带着必杀之志，丝毫不给来者救援的余地。
吴大奎顿时吓得亡魂皆冒：“统帅救命！”
他嘶声尖叫，双手胡乱挥舞，本能地想要挡住那夺命的一剑。
汤玉辉怒道：“你敢！”
他的声音如惊雷炸响，身形化作一道流光，拼命向这边冲来。
然而他还是慢了一步，秦峰这一剑直接将吴大奎脑袋斩了下来。
头颅高高飞起，无头尸身晃了晃，轰然倒地。
现场顿时陷入死一般的寂静，之前在城墙上那些士兵都噤若寒蝉。
连呼吸声都刻意压到最低，只剩寒风卷过战旗的猎猎声响。
这秦峰也太狠了，在统帅的眼皮底下居然斩杀了一名校尉。
众人望向他的眼神，从之前的轻视转为深深的敬畏与恐惧。
苗诗烟却一脸的崇拜，还得是秦峰，有仇当场就报，绝不含糊。
汤玉辉来晚了一步，他看着吴大奎的尸体，面露狰狞之色。
他双拳紧握，指节捏得发白，额角青筋如蚯蚓般暴起。
“秦峰，你当着我的面残杀同僚，真当我不敢杀你？”
周身气势陡然攀升，神君境的威压毫无保留地倾泻而出。
content_en:
Although Wu Dakui is in the true god realm, he really can't stand up to Qin Feng's strength.
He didn't even have time to react, he only felt a bit of murderous intent rushing towards him.
He immediately picked up the spear and held it in front of his chest. However, the next moment, he and the gun flew out directly and hit the city wall.
The barrel of the gun was bent into an arch shape, and his back hit the hard wall brick hard, and the gravel fell down.
Blood continued to pour from the corners of his mouth, and several ribs were broken. Blood dripped down his chin, and he turned pale in pain.
Wu Dakui said: "Master Qin, the academy has regulations that prohibit members of the same sect from killing each other."
He clutched his chest and his voice trembled, but still tried to suppress Qin Feng's anger with rules.
"As an inspector, if you know the law and break the law, you will be punished with an extra penalty. Can you afford the consequences?"
He secretly glanced in the direction of the Commander-in-Chief's Mansion, hoping that Tang Yuhui would arrive soon.
Although he said something tough, he had actually already summoned Tang Yuhui.
He also didn't expect Qin Feng to be so strong, far beyond his expectation.
I originally thought that the Qiling Dynasty could easily deal with these two people, but unexpectedly the situation changed.
Qin Feng sneered: "Now that you know you can't kill each other, what have you been doing?"
He took a step forward, and the lightning on the sword's edge crackled before it dissipated.
"You didn't open the city gates before, shutting us out, and almost killed us. Why didn't you say that we are prohibited from killing each other?"
That question was like a heavy hammer hitting the hearts of all the guards present, and no one dared to answer.
Wu Dakui immediately changed his face to a smile: "Isn't that also the responsibility before?"
He tried hard to put on a flattering smile, but the wound made him grin, making him look funny and embarrassed.
"Brother Qin, please don't remember the villain's fault. I won't dare to do it next time."
At this moment, a terrifying aura suddenly came from the Commander-in-Chief's Mansion, and it was obvious that Tang Yuhui was coming here.
The pressure was like a mountain falling, and the soldiers on the tower bowed their heads and remained silent.
Qin Feng sneered: "Do you think informing the commander can save your life?" As he said that, he drew his sword and slashed.
The light of the sword was like a white rainbow penetrating the sun, with the determination to kill, leaving no room for rescue to the comer.
Wu Dakui was immediately frightened to death: "Commander, help me!"
He screamed and waved his hands wildly, instinctively trying to block the fatal sword.
Tang Yuhui said angrily: "How dare you!"
His voice sounded like thunder, and his body turned into a stream of light, rushing towards this side with all his strength.
However, he was still a step too slow, and Qin Feng's sword directly chopped off Wu Dakui's head.
The head flew high, and the headless body shook and fell to the ground.
The scene suddenly fell into deathly silence, and the soldiers who had been on the city wall were silent.
Even the sound of breathing was deliberately kept to a minimum, leaving only the sound of the cold wind blowing through the battle flag.
This Qin Feng was so ruthless that he actually killed a school captain under the eyes of the commander-in-chief.
The eyes of everyone looking at him changed from the previous contempt to deep awe and fear.
Miao Shiyan, however, had a look of admiration on her face. It was Qin Feng who would avenge him on the spot without any ambiguity.
Tang Yuhui arrived a step late. He looked at Wu Dakui's body with a ferocious look on his face.
He clenched his fists so tightly that his knuckles turned white, and the veins on his forehead popped out like earthworms.
"Qin Feng, you killed your colleagues in front of me, do you really think I don't dare to kill you?"
The momentum around him suddenly rose, and the pressure of the Divine Lord Realm poured out without reservation.
